sources.entry: Durable - AI-powered website builder that can create a functional website in under a minute, focusing on simplicity and speed.
Durable - Build a website in 30 seconds with AI, leveraging AI-powered design and marketing tools to boost traffic and increase revenue. #freemium

summary.name: Durable
summary.one_liner: Durable is an AI business builder that generates a website in about 30 seconds and bundles CRM, bookings, AI marketing, and SEO tools into one subscription.
use_cases: Launching a website for a service business quickly
Managing leads and customers in a built-in CRM
Letting customers book appointments from a website
Creating on-brand images for logos, ads, and websites
Improving search visibility and reviews for a local business
Consolidating several business subscriptions into one plan
summary.what_it_does: Durable builds a website for a business using AI, with the page claiming it can be online in about 30 seconds. It includes an AI image studio for logos, ads and site images, and SEO and GEO tools aimed at attracting leads from Google AI and ChatGPT. A built-in CRM tracks leads and customers, and a booking feature lets customers schedule services from the website. The page also describes an AI assistant that answers business questions such as marketing campaigns and pricing, and it says Durable handles payment processing. Templates are shown for many trades, including coaching, handyman, cleaning, landscaping and photography.
notable: Website generated by AI in about 30 seconds
Integrated CRM, bookings and payments in one app
AI image studio and SEO/GEO tools
Advertised Launch plan at $25/mo versus a claimed $396/m typical spend on separate tools
caveats: Page lists a $25/mo Launch plan and says 'Get started for free', but the free tier's limits are not described
Claims such as 'Trusted by 3 million businesses' and '11M+ websites generated' are marketing figures not verified here
Pricing comparison ($396/m typical spend) is the vendor's own estimate
